releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Update to Minecraft 26.2 and upgrade Fabric Loader, Loom, Baritone, Minescript, and Catppuccin theme addon
* Add **AutoBrush** - automatically brushes suspicious sand and gravel
* Add **FollowTrader** - makes the trader follow you by hiding the trade screen
* Add **InventoryOrganizer** with per-slot rules (Simple item lists or Advanced Starscript expressions), execution modes, and a dedicated rule editor
* Add **Walkerist** - queue-based pathfinding with the vanilla A* PathFinder, waypoints, door opening, cleanup, logging and rendering, and a `walkerist` command to manage the queue
* **ItemSucker**: add new Walkerist movement mode (now default) and improved return-to-origin
* Introduce **Filterist** - adds an `item` variable to Meteor's Starscript for matching items by id, count, and NBT/data components, plus a `filterist` command to test expressions
* Replace old NBT path/regex filters in **AutoTrade** and **SlotClick** with Starscript expressions
* Add held-item whitelist/blacklist filtering to **ZKillaura** and **ZAimbot**
* Add a **Keybinds** tab with a full keyboard/mouse overview
* Add two new HUD elements: `keybinds` (occupied Meteor/vanilla keybinds) and `minescript-scripts` (running Minescript jobs)
* Add a brand-new module config preset system with a dedicated presets screen
* Add custom Meteorist category colors applied via new GUI mixins
* Rework **AutoCrafter** whitelist matching and drop the `use-first-matching-variant` setting
* Fix minor issues in `RangeActions`, `AutoSleep`, `BoatControl`, `DmSpam`, `InteractCommand`, `Instructions`, `PlayersInfoCommand` and others
* Overhaul the website with a new design, module/command/HUD browser, and changelog section + rework `MeteoristInfoParser`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/compare/v26.1.2-1...v26.2-1

## What's Changed
* Update to Minecraft 1.21.11 and upgrade Fabric Loader, Loom, and Gradle
* Overhaul **ZAimbot** with fully customizable projectile trajectories (snowballs, eggs, etc.) and GUI for managing them
* Easter egg has been added! Try downloading latest version and typing `🌠` in the chat
* Launch new official website with auto-generated module/command browser and one-click downloads
* Refactor CI workflows to commit generated JSON metadata directly to main repo (no longer uses separate website repo)
* Improve `MeteoristInfoParser` with better `Category` resolution and file caching for reliable metadata extraction
* Fix minor issues in `AutoSleep`, `ItemsSetting`, and various entity imports due to Minecraft 1.21.11 package changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/compare/v1.21.10-1...v1.21.11-1

## What's Changed
* Update to Minecraft 1.21.10 by @ProsperFall in [#65](https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/pull/65)
* Migrate to Mojang’s official mappings (replacing Yarn), preparing for 1.21.11+ updates
* Added Minescript integration module – control and monitor Minescript stuff directly from Meteorist
* Added SignSearch module – find and highlight signs using regex patterns, with in-game GUI and navigation support
* Enhanced ZAimbot with independent yaw/pitch control, instant aim toggles, and other changes
* Fixed DmSpam infinite loop when `disableOnExit` is enabled
* Fixed `ItemsSetting` not loading saved items; also updated `ItemsSetting` and `StringPairSetting` NBT handling for consistency
* Various other improvements and fixes

releases.notes:
## What's Changed

* Updated version format to match Meteor's convention
* Added several new GitHub Workflows
* Rewrote `AutoCrafter` to use the recipe book for crafting; improved performance and reliability on higher ping connections
* Integrated `DocsGenerator` into the build as a dev module (can be enabled via Meteor settings)
* Introduced `MeteoristInfoParser` as a more robust alternative to `DocsGenerator`
* Reverted to Groovy DSL for build scripts
* Converted Access Widener usages to Mixins for better compatibility and maintainability
* Added ZAutoTotem by @Rapou7 in https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/pull/54
* Updated DataCommand.java by @Gamer-friend in https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/pull/55
* Various other improvements and fixes

## New Contributors

* @Rapou7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/pull/54
* @Gamer-friend made their first contribution in https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/pull/55

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/compare/v1.12...v1.21.8-1
